summary: Iteration 2 regression + redesign testing: font bug fix, logo replacement, redesigned dashboard widgets, drag&drop upload with size persistence, animated AI workflow, workflow timeline, approve + export actions, mobile responsiveness. Backend: 17/17 pytest passing (added new dashboard field + size persistence checks). Frontend: full E2E flow works — login, dashboard widgets, upload modal, real Claude AI plan generation (~15s), approve, all export buttons render, billing 3 plans, mobile drawer.

ui_bugs.issue: When project.status === 'approved', flowIndex() returns 5, so timeline only lights up steps at positions 1/3/5 (Upload, Analiză AI, Review). 'Aprobare' (pos 7) and 'Export' (pos 9) stay empty even though the user just approved. Expected: approved status should light up at least through 'Aprobare' (and arguably 'Export'). Fix idea: return 9 for 'approved'.

action_items: Optional: bump flowIndex('approved') to 9 so the Aprobare/Export nodes in the workflow timeline are marked complete after approval.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css imports Sora + Inter + JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts; consider self-hosting or preloading to avoid FOUT on cold loads (minor).
ProjectDetail.jsx flowIndex mapping is off-by-one for terminal states (see UI bug).
downloadSRT relies on plan.subtitles being present — no guard if plan is null (button only renders in approved branch which needs plan, so OK in practice, but a safe fallback would help).
server.py dashboard_stats iterates all projects to sum size (async for) — fine at MVP scale; can be replaced by an aggregation pipeline as data grows.
server.py still returns storage_gb_limit hardcoded to 25 regardless of plan — consider tying to PLAN_META.
Previous review comments from iteration_1 still stand (server.py size, CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials, /api/plans hits Stripe every call, storage_key cache without refresh).
seed_data_creation: Playwright test created + deleted a TEST_UI_Reel project. One earlier TEST_FE_Project (from a prior UI iteration) still exists in the demo coach account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests now assert new dashboard fields (credits_remaining, storage_bytes, storage_gb_limit, time_saved_min) and that size is persisted on POST /api/projects. Playwright: after login, wait ~3s before navigating away — sonner toast can overlap and intercept clicks on the /projects Încarcă video button. Upload input is [data-testid=projects-upload-input] (hidden), use set_input_files. Real Claude plan takes ~10-20s.
rca of the issue: Font-heading bug (previous iter): Sora Google Font is now imported and .font-heading applies it — headings render clearly (verified computed font-family = 'Sora, sans-serif'). Logo bug: /public/logo.jpeg is rendered via Logo.jsx <img/> in DashboardLayout sidebar, mobile drawer header, and Login/Register pages (verified visible in screenshots). Minor remaining: workflow timeline flowIndex mapping doesn't fully advance for 'approved' status.
